rationale: Correct the existing Sequitur Renewables record in place and map ArcLight's short census label Sequitur to that canonical company. ArcLight and company transaction materials identify Sequitur as Sequitur Renewables, LLC, so a new company would be duplicative. ArcLight's current portfolio still lists Sequitur as current, ArcLight's 2025 ESG report and direct GLEIF records attribute the company to ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P., and no Sequitur-level exit or signed pending sale was identified through August 15, 2026. The initial five-project 185 MW PJM wind acquisition closed in October 2022; FERC and the PJM Market Monitor differ by one day, so only month precision is persisted. ArcLight's numeric platform stake, immediate legal holding vehicle, and operating headquarters are not publicly disclosed and remain null. The individual wind farms and Diablo Wind are assets beneath the one manager-level platform.

beforeImage.name: Sequitur Renewables
beforeImage.description: Sequitur Renewables is an operating renewable-energy platform built around wind assets and related optimization opportunities. The business serves wholesale power markets through an asset-heavy operating model focused on existing projects rather than early-stage development alone. ArcLight launched the platform in 2022 with the acquisition of a 185 MW wind portfolio in PJM spanning Pennsylvania and West Virginia, and later expanded it with an operating California wind farm in Altamont Pass. The platform is therefore oriented toward ownership, operation, and commercial optimization of renewable assets across multiple markets. ArcLight established Sequitur in 2022 and public sources do not disclose the detailed ownership percentages within the platform.

afterImage.name: Sequitur Renewables
afterImage.description: Sequitur Renewables is an ArcLight-backed U.S. renewable-energy platform that owns and operates wind assets. ArcLight established the platform in 2022 around five operating PJM wind farms totaling 185 MW in Pennsylvania and West Virginia; public regulatory sources establish an October 2022 closing but conflict on the exact day. Sequitur expanded into California in May 2023 by acquiring an operating wind farm in Altamont Pass. ArcLight's current portfolio lists Sequitur as current, and ArcLight and GLEIF records attribute the company to ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P. Public sources do not disclose ArcLight's platform-level stake or immediate legal acquisition vehicle. No Sequitur-level exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.
